title: Reading the Word
definition: Reading the Word is the regular practice of receiving Scripture directly through attentive, reverent, and prayerful reading.
summary: Believers read Scripture because God has spoken and the soul needs His truth.
christFocus: Reading Scripture brings believers again and again to Christ, the Gospel, and the promises of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Reading Scripture is one of the ordinary ways believers receive God's truth. The Bible is meant to be heard, read, studied, meditated on, remembered, and obeyed.

Regular reading helps form the mind and heart over time. It exposes believers to the breadth of God's Word and keeps faith rooted in what God has said.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Believers can become spiritually weak when they live on secondhand truth only. Reading the Word matters because each person needs direct, regular contact with Scripture.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Set a sustainable rhythm for reading Scripture. Read prayerfully, attentively, and with a willingness to obey what God shows you.
